attempts.name: a_i_on_Q_q
attempts.reason: No identity forces D=0 for the genuine G3-frame point a_i. The cubic condition Phi(a_i)=0 is independent of the polar quadric Q_q of the tautological ambient point q. Modular probes (secondary-0 specializations of M, independent of a_i expansion) show Q_q is a nondegenerate form; without D=0 the candidate fails.
